---
title: "linear_features_ssf_kaza"
author: "Rachel Frost"
date: "2026-11-05"
output: html_document
---

Adds fence, road, and river crossing indicators to the KAZA seasonal SSF (no movement
terms, per team decision Nov 1 2026), with the same tests as the Etosha and West scripts:

1. step-length robustness check (refit with `sl_ + log_sl_`)
2. three scenarios: distance-to only / distance-to + crossings / crossings replace distance-to
3. how every coefficient shifts when crossings or step length are added

Starts from the saved 1-hr KAZA extractions (`ele_trk_extract_kaza_wet.rds`,
`ele_trk_extract_kaza_dry.rds`), which already have the `_linear` columns from
`extract_linear()`, so no re-extraction is needed for crossings.

Differences from the West script:

- KAZA comes as two seasonal files, so each season is prepped and fit separately (never bound
  together, which saves memory).
- KAZA's land cover has not had the Oct 21 `extract_lc_mixed()` rerun yet. `lc_mode` picks
  binary land cover if present and otherwise falls back to the `_dist` versions. Results with
  `_dist` land cover are fine for the crossing questions but their habitat terms are not
  directly comparable to Etosha/West.
- River crossings are included: KAZA's rivers are perennial and inside the river layer's
  extent (all steps 20.0–25.0°E; layer runs to 25.5°E).
- Crossing terms with too few used crossings are dropped automatically (`min_used_cross`).
- Fits are cached with a signature (formulas + row counts); if you change settings, the cache
  is detected as stale and refit instead of silently reloaded.

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(amt)
library(survival)
select <- dplyr::select
```

## 0. Settings

```{r settings}
lc_mode        <- "auto"   # "auto" (binary if present, else _dist), "binary", or "dist"
drop_water     <- FALSE    # TRUE also drops water_rivers_dist in scenario 3
min_used_cross <- 30       # crossing terms with fewer used crossings in either season are dropped
```

## 0b. Optional: test whether the binary land cover rasters cover KAZA

Run this once before deciding on `extract_lc_mixed()` for KAZA. If the binary layers were
clipped to Namibia's western/central extent, many KAZA endpoints come back NA. Not evaluated
when knitting.

```{r}
for (s in c("wet", "dry")) {
  out <- here("outputs", paste0("ele_trk_extract_kaza_", s, "_lcmixed.rds"))
  if (file.exists(out)) { cat(s, "already done\n"); next }

  d  <- readRDS(here("outputs", paste0("ele_trk_extract_kaza_", s, ".rds")))
  n0 <- nrow(d)

  d <- d |>
    select(-any_of(c("cropland_dist", "urban_dist", "water_rivers_dist"))) |>  # re-extracted (identical)
    extract_lc_mixed()

  stopifnot(nrow(d) == n0)                                                      # no rows lost
  cat(s, "rows:", nrow(d), "| binary NAs:",
      colSums(is.na(d[, c("grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover")])), "\n")
  saveRDS(d, out)
  rm(d); gc()
}
```


```{r lc-coverage-test, eval = FALSE}
kaza_test <- readRDS(here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_kaza_wet.rds")) |> slice_sample(n = 5000)
kaza_test <- extract_lc_mixed(kaza_test)   # same call as the Etosha/West pipeline
colSums(is.na(kaza_test[, c("grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover")]))   # should be ~0
range(kaza_test$x2_); range(kaza_test$y2_)
rm(kaza_test); gc()
```

## 1. Load extracted steps

```{r load}
kaza_files <- c(wet = "ele_trk_extract_kaza_wet_lcmixed.rds",
                dry = "ele_trk_extract_kaza_dry_lcmixed.rds")

kaza_raw <- imap(kaza_files, ~ readRDS(here("outputs", .x)) |> mutate(season = .y))
map_int(kaza_raw, nrow)   # wet: 4,968,821
```

## 2. Checks before prep

Every line here should pass before fitting anything.

```{r checks}
# --- 1-hr steps, step lengths, extent ---
check_season <- function(d, s) {
  obs <- d |> filter(case_)
  dt  <- as.numeric(difftime(obs$t2_, obs$t1_, units = "mins"))
  tibble(season = s, rows = nrow(d), used = nrow(obs),
         median_dt_min = median(dt, na.rm = TRUE),
         pct_dt_45_75  = mean(between(dt, 45, 75), na.rm = TRUE),   # should be near 1
         sl_na = sum(is.na(d$sl_)), sl_le0 = sum(d$sl_ <= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
         sl_median = median(d$sl_, na.rm = TRUE),   # < ~0.1 = degrees; hundreds = meters
         x2_min = min(d$x2_, na.rm = TRUE), x2_max = max(d$x2_, na.rm = TRUE))
}
imap_dfr(kaza_raw, check_season)

# --- columns ---
lin_cols  <- c("kaza_vet_fences_linear", "roads_linear", "hydrorivers_linear")
dist_lin  <- c("fence_dist", "road_dist", "water_rivers_dist")
hab_terms <- c("cropland_dist", "urban_dist", "elevation", "slope", "aspect", "evi", "world_pop")
lc_binary <- c("grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover")
lc_dist   <- paste0(lc_binary, "_dist")

nm <- Reduce(intersect, map(kaza_raw, names))   # columns present in BOTH seasons

lc_terms <- switch(lc_mode,
                   binary = lc_binary,
                   dist   = lc_dist,
                   auto   = if (all(lc_binary %in% nm)) lc_binary else lc_dist)
cat("Land cover terms:", lc_terms, "\n")
if (identical(lc_terms, lc_dist)) {
  message("Using distance-to land cover (no extract_lc_mixed() rerun yet). ",
          "Crossing results are fine; habitat terms are not directly comparable to Etosha/West.")
}

needed  <- c("id", "step_id_", "case_", "sl_", "t1_", "t2_",
             lin_cols, dist_lin, hab_terms, lc_terms)
missing <- setdiff(needed, nm)
if (length(missing)) stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

# --- step IDs: already prefixed with the elephant id? ---
map(kaza_raw, ~ head(.x$step_id_))

# --- NAs in land cover (binary NAs are about to become 0 = "not this class") ---
map(kaza_raw, ~ colSums(is.na(.x[, lc_terms])))
```

## 3. Prep: step IDs, crossing indicators, land cover NAs

Crossing columns come from `extract_linear()`: the max of each 500m line raster along the
step, so "crossed" = the step passed through a cell containing the feature. The river layer is
binary (1 = mapped river cell; mean discharge ≥ 10 m³/s).

```{r prep}
prep_season <- function(d) {
  # only prefix step_id_ if it isn't already unique across elephants
  prefixed <- all(str_starts(as.character(d$step_id_), paste0(d$id, "_")))

  d <- d |>
    mutate(
      step_id_ = if (prefixed) as.character(step_id_) else paste(id, step_id_, sep = "_"),
      across(all_of(lin_cols), ~ replace(.x, is.infinite(.x) | is.na(.x), 0)),  # -Inf/NA = no feature (works for int or double)
      fence_cross = as.integer(kaza_vet_fences_linear > 0),
      road_cross  = as.integer(roads_linear > 0),
      river_cross = as.integer(hydrorivers_linear > 0)    # 1 = mapped river cell
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(sl_), sl_ > 0)                          # log_sl_ must be finite

  if (identical(lc_terms, lc_binary)) {
    d <- d |> mutate(across(all_of(lc_binary), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))
  }
  d
}

kaza <- map(kaza_raw, prep_season)
rm(kaza_raw); gc()

# checkpoint: strata intact (each step_id_ has exactly 1 used step)
iwalk(kaza, function(d, s) {
  sc <- d |> group_by(step_id_) |> summarise(n_case = sum(case_), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  cat("\n", s, "- strata:", nrow(sc), "\n")
  print(table(sc$n_case))   # all 1s
  print(summary(sc$n))      # mostly 11
})
```

## 3b. Crossing counts: which crossing terms can be estimated?

```{r crossing-counts}
cross_all <- c("fence_cross", "road_cross", "river_cross")

used_cross <- imap_dfr(kaza, ~ .x |> filter(case_) |>
                         summarise(across(all_of(cross_all), sum), n_used = n()) |>
                         mutate(season = .y, .before = 1))
used_cross

avail_cross <- imap_dfr(kaza, ~ .x |> filter(!case_) |>
                          summarise(across(all_of(cross_all), sum), n_avail = n()) |>
                          mutate(season = .y, .before = 1))
avail_cross

cross_terms <- cross_all[map_lgl(cross_all, ~ min(used_cross[[.x]]) >= min_used_cross)]
cat("Crossing terms used:", cross_terms, "\n")
dropped <- setdiff(cross_all, cross_terms)
if (length(dropped)) message("Dropped (< ", min_used_cross, " used crossings in a season): ",
                             paste(dropped, collapse = ", "))

# overlap between each crossing indicator and its distance-to term (available steps)
imap_dfr(kaza, ~ .x |> filter(!case_) |>
           summarise(fence = cor(fence_cross, fence_dist),
                     road  = cor(road_cross, road_dist),
                     river_vs_water = cor(river_cross, water_rivers_dist)) |>
           mutate(season = .y, .before = 1))
```

## 3c. Save prepped steps (for BCI)

`outputs/` is gitignored and the files are large; share via the team drive, not git. List
columns (raw along-step values) are dropped; the summarized columns already exist. File names
say `_lcdist` if the land cover is still distance-to.

```{r save-linecross}
iwalk(kaza, function(d, s) {
  p <- here("outputs", paste0("ele_trk_extract_kaza_", s, "_linecross",
                              if (identical(lc_terms, lc_dist)) "_lcdist", ".rds"))
  if (!file.exists(p)) {
    d |> select(-any_of(c("terrain_list", "linear_list"))) |> saveRDS(p)
  }
})
```

## 4. Formulas and model data

Every model below is fit on the same NA-filtered rows per season, so AIC/BIC are comparable
across all scenarios and the step-length check.

```{r formulas}
make_f <- function(terms) reformulate(c(terms, "strata(step_id_)"), response = "case_")

main_terms <- c(dist_lin, hab_terms, lc_terms, cross_terms)

# scenario 3: each crossing term replaces its own distance-to term;
# river_cross has no pair (water_rivers_dist is land-cover water, kept unless drop_water)
pairs            <- c(fence_cross = "fence_dist", road_cross = "road_dist")
replaced         <- unname(pairs[intersect(names(pairs), cross_terms)])
cross_only_terms <- setdiff(main_terms, c(replaced, if (drop_water) "water_rivers_dist"))

f_main       <- make_f(main_terms)                              # 2. distance-to + crossings
f_slcheck    <- make_f(c(main_terms, "sl_", "log_sl_"))         # robustness check
f_base       <- make_f(c(dist_lin, hab_terms, lc_terms))        # 1. distance-to only
f_cross_only <- make_f(cross_only_terms)                        # 3. crossings replace distance-to

f_main
f_cross_only

model_vars <- unique(c(main_terms, "sl_", "case_", "step_id_"))
kaza_model_dat <- map(kaza, ~ .x |> drop_na(all_of(model_vars)) |> mutate(log_sl_ = log(sl_)))

# checkpoint: rows dropped by the NA filter (should be 0 or very few)
map2_int(kaza, kaza_model_dat, ~ nrow(.x) - nrow(.y))

rm(kaza); gc()
```

## 5. Fit (cached)

Four models per season on ~4–5M rows each, so this takes a while. The cache stores a
signature (formulas, settings, row counts); if any of those change, it refits instead of
loading stale fits.

```{r fit}
fit_sig <- list(formulas   = map_chr(list(f_main, f_slcheck, f_base, f_cross_only),
                                     ~ paste(deparse(.x), collapse = "")),
                lc_terms   = lc_terms,
                drop_water = drop_water,
                n          = map_int(kaza_model_dat, nrow))

cached <- function(path, sig, expr) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    obj <- readRDS(path)
    if (identical(obj$sig, sig)) return(obj$value)
    message("Cache is stale (settings or data changed), refitting: ", basename(path))
  }
  value <- expr   # evaluated only here
  saveRDS(list(sig = sig, value = value), path)
  value
}

lc_tag <- if (identical(lc_terms, lc_dist)) "_lcdist" else ""

kaza_fits <- cached(
  here("outputs", paste0("kaza_ssf_crossing_fits", lc_tag, ".rds")), fit_sig,
  map(kaza_model_dat, ~ list(main    = fit_clogit(.x, f_main, model = FALSE),
                             slcheck = fit_clogit(.x, f_slcheck, model = FALSE))))

scen_fits <- cached(
  here("outputs", paste0("kaza_ssf_scenario_fits", lc_tag, if (drop_water) "_nowater", ".rds")),
  fit_sig,
  map(kaza_model_dat, ~ list(base       = fit_clogit(.x, f_base, model = FALSE),
                             cross_only = fit_clogit(.x, f_cross_only, model = FALSE))))

summary(kaza_fits$wet$main)
summary(kaza_fits$dry$main)
```

## 6. Robustness to step length

`shift_over_se` = change in each crossing coefficient when step length is added, in units of
the main model's SE. |shift| < ~2 SE = robust. `sl_` units don't matter here (`log_sl_` only
shifts by a constant and `sl_` rescales its own coefficient), but don't compare `sl_`
coefficients across populations.

```{r robustness}
robustness <- map_dfr(names(kaza_fits), function(s) {
  m  <- summary(kaza_fits[[s]]$main)$coefficients[cross_terms, , drop = FALSE]
  sc <- summary(kaza_fits[[s]]$slcheck)$coefficients[cross_terms, , drop = FALSE]
  tibble(season = s, term = cross_terms,
         coef_main = m[, "coef"], se_main = m[, "se(coef)"],
         rel_sel_main = exp(m[, "coef"]),
         coef_sl = sc[, "coef"],
         shift_over_se = (sc[, "coef"] - m[, "coef"]) / m[, "se(coef)"])
})
robustness
```

## 7. Three scenarios: add vs. replace

```{r scenarios}
scenario_table <- map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), function(s) {
  mods <- list("1. distance-to only"              = scen_fits[[s]]$base$model,
               "2. distance-to + crossings"       = kaza_fits[[s]]$main$model,
               "3. crossings replace distance-to" = scen_fits[[s]]$cross_only$model)
  stopifnot(n_distinct(map_int(mods, "n")) == 1)    # same rows in all three
  tibble(season = s, scenario = names(mods),
         n   = map_int(mods, "n"),
         k   = map_int(mods, ~ length(coef(.x))),
         AIC = map_dbl(mods, AIC),
         BIC = map_dbl(mods, BIC)) |>
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))
})
scenario_table

# crossing coefficients with vs without the distance-to terms
map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), ~ tibble(
  season = .x, term = cross_terms,
  with_dist    = coef(kaza_fits[[.x]]$main$model)[cross_terms],
  without_dist = coef(scen_fits[[.x]]$cross_only$model)[cross_terms]))

# step-length check vs main (same rows, so AIC is comparable)
map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), ~ tibble(
  season = .x, model = c("SSF + crossings", "+ sl_ + log_sl_"),
  AIC = c(AIC(kaza_fits[[.x]]$main$model), AIC(kaza_fits[[.x]]$slcheck$model))) |>
  mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC)))
```

```{r}
#Plot to visualize linear features + movement

library(terra)

# --- sampled used locations (both seasons) ---
kaza_pts <- imap_dfr(kaza_model_dat, ~ .x |> filter(case_) |>
                       slice_sample(n = 15000) |>
                       select(x2_, y2_) |> mutate(season = .y))

# plot window: elephant range + 0.75° buffer, so nearby fences outside the range show up too
bb <- c(xmin = min(kaza_pts$x2_) - 0.75, xmax = max(kaza_pts$x2_) + 0.75,
        ymin = min(kaza_pts$y2_) - 0.75, ymax = max(kaza_pts$y2_) + 0.75)

# --- linear feature cells from the 500 m rasters the model used ---
lin_cells <- function(file, label) {
  r <- rast(here("data", "Linear_features", file))
  e <- project(ext(bb["xmin"], bb["xmax"], bb["ymin"], bb["ymax"]),
               from = "EPSG:4326", to = crs(r))
  df <- r |> crop(e) |> project("EPSG:4326", method = "near") |> as.data.frame(xy = TRUE)
  df <- df[df[[3]] > 0, c("x", "y")]
  cat(label, ":", nrow(df), "cells\n")              # checkpoint
  df |> mutate(feature = label)
}

kaza_lines <- bind_rows(
  lin_cells("roads_linear_500m.tif",           "Road"),
  lin_cells("hydrorivers_linear_500m.tif",     "River"),
  lin_cells("kaza_vet_fences_linear_500m.tif", "Vet fence")
) |>
  mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = c("Road", "River", "Vet fence")))  # fences drawn last (on top)

# --- plot ---
p_kaza_lin <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = kaza_pts, aes(x2_, y2_), colour = "grey55", size = 0.15, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = kaza_lines |> arrange(feature),
             aes(x, y, colour = feature), shape = 15, size = 0.35) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Road" = "#E69F00", "River" = "#0072B2", "Vet fence" = "#D7191C"),
                      name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~ season, ncol = 1) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = bb[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = bb[c("ymin", "ymax")], expand = FALSE) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  labs(title = "KAZA elephant locations and linear features used in the SSF",
       subtitle = "Grey = used steps (15k sample per season); features = 500 m crossing rasters",
       caption = "Used fence crossings: 4 (wet), 8 (dry); random-step fence crossings: 269 (wet), 70 (dry)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

p_kaza_lin

dir.create(here("outputs", "figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", "kaza_points_linear_features.png"),
       p_kaza_lin, width = 9, height = 10, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
```


## 8. How every coefficient shifts: base → + crossings → + movement terms

Shifts are in units of the main model's SE, so they're comparable across covariates on very
different scales. |shift| > ~2 SE = worth noting.

```{r coef-compare}
coef_compare <- map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), function(s) {
  b  <- coef(scen_fits[[s]]$base$model)
  m  <- coef(kaza_fits[[s]]$main$model)
  mv <- coef(kaza_fits[[s]]$slcheck$model)
  se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(kaza_fits[[s]]$main$model)))
  terms <- names(m)
  tibble(season = s, term = terms,
         base = b[terms], with_cross = m, with_move = mv[terms], se_main = se,
         shift_cross_se = (m - b[terms]) / se,     # effect of adding crossings
         shift_move_se  = (mv[terms] - m) / se)    # effect of adding movement terms
})

coef_compare |> select(season, term, shift_cross_se, shift_move_se) |>
  arrange(season, desc(abs(shift_cross_se)))
coef_compare |> select(season, term, shift_cross_se, shift_move_se) |>
  arrange(season, desc(abs(shift_move_se)))

# save summary tables for the cross-population comparison
saveRDS(list(scenario_table = scenario_table, robustness = robustness,
             coef_compare = coef_compare, used_cross = used_cross,
             cross_terms = cross_terms, lc_terms = lc_terms),
        here("outputs", paste0("kaza_linear_summary", lc_tag, ".rds")))
```
